statements.markdown: **Theorem 5.8 (Odd support).** *For every integer $b\ge2$, the series $\sum_{n\ge1,\ n\text{ odd}}(b^n-1)^{-1}$ is irrational. This density-$1/2$ support is the case treated explicitly by Luca and Tachiya \[[3](#ref-lucatachiya2017), Example 2, p. 140\].*
